pairing_rule: For each in-window original 10-K, validate the census-selected latest eligible original 8-K whose SEC acceptance timestamp is strictly after the previous original 10-K acceptance and strictly before the target 10-K acceptance. Eligible means 8-K, not 8-K/A, with a predeclared earnings marker.
pit_rule: Use only SEC public filing metadata and acceptance timestamps. Missing timestamps are never imputed. Equal-second target/pair timestamps are rejected as temporally ambiguous.
